name: find_supplier
title: Find supplier
description: Look a supplier up by name, tolerating different spellings. Returns the closest matches with code, city, status and whether they hold a valid UN 38.3 certificate. Use it before registering anyone new.

name.description: the supplier's name as the user said it

city.description: optional city, to tell two branches apart

ok.description: true when it worked; false comes with error and next_step

matches.description: supplier_code, name, city, state, status, similarity
